# Laconic

> A skill for coding agents and chat assistants that makes the model lead with the answer,
> mark what it has not verified and write in Australian English, plus a prose skill that
> humanises AI-written text. The bundled checker's findings are reasons to look, not proof of a defect.

The plugin manifests are at version 0.5.0. The latest GitHub release, `laconic-check-v0.3.0`,
ships prebuilt `laconic-check` binaries. For Claude Code, install with
`claude plugin marketplace add yungSNAT/laconic` then `claude plugin install laconic@laconic`.

## Start

- [README](https://github.com/yungSNAT/Laconic#readme): what changes, the evaluation, the checker and always-on setup.
- [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/yungSNAT/Laconic/blob/main/INSTALL.md): installation, verification and removal for each supported agent.
- [Session skill](https://github.com/yungSNAT/Laconic/blob/main/skills/laconic/SKILL.md): the canonical response rules.

## Docs

- [Prose skill](https://github.com/yungSNAT/Laconic/blob/main/skills/laconic-prose/SKILL.md): writing, editing, humanising and prose audits.
- [Compact rules](https://github.com/yungSNAT/Laconic/blob/main/rules/laconic.md): the always-loaded short form.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/yungSNAT/Laconic/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository map and checks for agents.
- [Evaluations](https://github.com/yungSNAT/Laconic/blob/main/evals/README.md): commands to validate, run and judge the evaluation cases.
- [Rubric](https://github.com/yungSNAT/Laconic/blob/main/evals/rubric.md): the response quality scoring contract.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/yungSNAT/Laconic/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): provenance, safety and verification rules for changes.
- [NOTICE](https://github.com/yungSNAT/Laconic/blob/main/NOTICE): licences of retained third-party material.
